hookSub: For the employee who keeps missing deadlines.
title: A full 1-on-1 plan in *seconds*
prompt: I'm a manager. Tomorrow I have a 1-on-1 with a great employee who missed 3 deadlines this month. Give me a 15-minute agenda with 5 questions to ask.
answer: 2 min check-in · 8 min questions · 5 min next steps

2. "A few deadlines slipped. What's getting in the way?"
